title: Lennar Expands New Home Offerings Across Loudoun County, One of Northern Virginia's Most Sought-After Markets

body_markdown:
ASHBURN , Va.


, Nov. 11, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, continues to expand its presence in Loudoun County, Virginia, with three new communities now selling and another set to open this fall, offering a range of home types, designs and price points from the $500,000s to $1.2 million.


Loudoun County has become one of Northern Virginia's most sought-after places to live, combining proximity to Washington, D.C., a strong economic hub, highly connected transportation infrastructure, and a distinctive quality of life. Washington Dulles International Airport, major commuter routes and the Silver Line, connect residents to the broader Washington metropolitan area. At the same time, the county offers a lifestyle that extends well beyond its employment centers, with rolling countryside, historic towns, farms, outdoor recreation and wineries and tasting rooms that have earned it a reputation as DC's Wine Country.


"Loudoun County represents exactly the type of market where Lennar wants to be," said Matthew Wineman, Lennar's Mid-Atlantic Division President. "It's an area with tremendous connectivity that offers the lifestyle, open space and amenities that people are looking for in a place to call home. Our goal is to bring new homes to locations where people want to live and where we can offer a variety of home designs to meet diverse needs and stages of life."


Lennar's Loudoun County communities reflect that strategy, with homes positioned in established and emerging areas that offer convenient access to employment, shopping, dining, recreation, and transportation. The distinct living experiences include:


**Kincora:** New three-bedroom, two and one-half bathroom townhome-style condos are now selling at Kincora, a walkable Loudoun County community surrounded by more than 165 acres of trails, parks and preserved green space. Homeowners will enjoy convenient access to Route 28 and Route 7. Ample options for shopping, dining and entertainment, including One Loudoun, are just minutes away.


**Goose Creek Village:** Goose Creek Village offers luxury two-story townhome style condos for sale, inclusive of three bedrooms and two and one-half bathrooms. Residents have access to onsite amenities including a swimming pool, clubhouse, tennis court and fitness center. The community provides convenient access to commuter routes and is walkable to shopping, dining and recreation, including nearby parks and the Village amphitheater.


**Chestnut Vale:** Chestnut Vale offers estate-style homes with three to six bedrooms and three to five bathrooms, on properties ranging from a quarter to a one and one-half acre. Located in western Loudoun County, the community combines the historic character of Lovettsville with access to restaurants, breweries, shops, outdoor recreation and major thoroughfares. Residents will also enjoy being situated within convenient reach of Washington Dulles International Airport, Washington, D.C., Frederick and Montgomery Counties in Maryland.


**Loudoun Grove:** Opening fall 2026, Loudoun Grove will offer a variety of modern condo floorplans with one to three bedrooms and one to two and one-half bathrooms, all within a lifestyle-driven community near Route 7 and Route 28. The community will feature onsite amenities including a clubhouse, pool, playground and walking trails, with convenient access to One Loudoun.


These communities demonstrate Lennar's approach to building in markets where location is a key part of the homebuying decision, offering homeowners the opportunity to live close to employment and everyday conveniences without giving up access to parks, trails, open space and the character that makes Loudoun County unique.


"People want more from where they live today. They want a home that works for their lifestyle. That means access to work and transportation, but also restaurants, shopping, recreation, outdoor space and places to spend time with family and friends," added Wineman. "Loudoun County delivers that combination, and we're excited to continue growing our presence here."


Every new home within these communities will come outfitted with popular features through Lennar's signature Everything's Included® program. Stainless steel appliances, quartz kitchen countertops, designer flooring packages, and more all come as standard, so homebuyers can have it all without having to pay extra.


For more information about new home opportunities in Loudoun County, visit[www.lennar.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820142-1&h=2031059998&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2F&a=www.lennar.com) .


**About Lennar Corporation**


Lennar Corporation is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making the American dream of homeownership attainable for more people. Since its founding in 1954, Lennar has built more than 1.5 million homes for buyers at every stage of life in communities across the country, from first-time and move-up buyers to active adults. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes. LENX drives Lennar's technology, innovation and strategic investments, shaping the future of homebuilding.
